# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits/{sha}

Get a single commit from a repository by SHA or ref

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-214`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| sha | path | string | True |
| stat | query | boolean | False |
| verification | query | boolean | False |
| files | query | boolean | False |

## Response

**200** — api.Commit

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `sha` | string | commit SHA |
| `url` | string | API URL |
| `html_url` | string | HTML URL |
| `commit` | RepoCommit | commit details (author, committer, message, tree, verification) |
| `author` | User | API user for author |
| `committer` | User | API user for committer |
| `parents` | []CommitMeta | parent commits |
| `files` | []CommitAffectedFiles | affected files (if files=true) |
| `stats` | CommitStats | diff stats (if stat=true) |

- **422** — sha is not a valid ref pattern
- **404** — commit does not exist

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| SHA must be a valid git ref pattern (no control chars, no .., no //, etc.) | validation | !git.IsValidRefPattern(sha) |
| Commit options (stat, verification, files) default to true when query param is empty string | business_logic | ctx.FormString("stat") == "" |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| sha fails IsValidRefPattern | 422 | validationError | False |
| commit not found in repo | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **invalid ref pattern** → GetSingleCommit → 422
- **commit not found** → getCommit → 404
- **internal git error** → getCommit → 500
